items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Charlie Barnet) does not speak about Bill Struther; the mention is made by the Interviewer describing an interaction between the Interviewer, Duke Ellington, and Bill Struther.

ctx.x: One of the things that you probably don't know -- I just told Bill Struther the other day, that you know he had come back to get an interview with Duke, and when you and Duke got into this he turned his tape recorder on, and I thought, 'Oh, great. He has a record of this, because I'd like to listen to this again.' After Duke had to go onstage for the next show --
What'd he do, erase it accidentally?
